property_summary: The reference contract always transfers the exact `_value` amount of Ether to `_target` via `sendMoney`, ensuring `_target`'s balance increases accordingly; the buggy version sends no Ether, so `_target`'s balance remains unchanged.
change_summary: Replace _target.call{value: _value}(_data) with _target.call(_data), removing the value transfer so sendMoney no longer sends Ether.
